segments.en: Hello, where is this, where is it?
Are you doing well? Are you doing well? Are you doing well? Are you doing well?

segments.text: എന്ത് ചെയ്യുവാണ് വീട്ടിലാണോ ഓഫീസിലാണോ ഞാൻ പുറത്താണ് താനെവിടെയാണ് ഞാൻ എൻ്റെ വീട്ടിലാണ് എവിടെയാണ്
segments.en: What are you doing? Are you at home? Are you at the office? I am outside. Where are you? I am at my home. Where are you?
I'm sure it will be obtained properly.
